descriptionMarkdown:
An Autocrafter / Automall that automatically produces a lot of parts in space. Much can be produced from Asteroids, it will produce a few more things if you shoot up the missing materials.
I use it mainly for supplying basic materials to Aquilo, but of course it works elsewhere.

Notes:
- This needs to fly regularly, else it probably won't catch enough material.
- the few legendary parts in this can just be replaced with normal parts - it will work, just a bit slower. Everything else is normal quality anyways.
- the core autocrafter in the middle next to the space hub is not my design - it is recycled from "Legendary space mall" posted by "anonymous" at https://factoriobin.com/post/5crtdz
- for kickstarting the oil processing, you will need to shoot up a few heavy oil barrels.
- this is nuclear powered and needs to be supplied with nuclear fuel cells regularly.
title: Foxis Space Autocrafter / Automall
